summary: Full backend and frontend testing of Parlance chat app. 15/15 backend tests passed. All core frontend flows verified: login, signup, channels, messaging, DM, settings, logout.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate messages appear in chat after sending. Console shows 'Encountered two children with the same key'. Possible cause: sender receives their own WS broadcast (no exclude=user_id in broadcast_room), and if message state already has the message from optimistic update OR double WS subscription.
Reaction button hover does not reliably open emoji picker in playwright (times out) - may be a CSS hover dependency issue

issues: New signup user only sees general/random channels in sidebar (no announcements - this is expected per code)

action_items: Investigate duplicate message issue: backend broadcast_room sends to sender too (no exclude); check if frontend has double WS subscription or double state update for sender's own messages
Consider adding exclude=user_id in broadcast_room for messages since sender should add message via API response, not WS (or add dedup check in frontend WS handler)
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate message bug: In server.py line 560, broadcast_room sends message to sender too (no exclude param). Frontend sendMessage only does REST call but doesn't add message to state. WS event adds it. This is correct single-path. BUT if WS double-connects (race condition or React strict mode), message is added twice. Add deduplication in WS onmessage handler: check if message ID already exists in state before adding.

Button nesting hydration error: Console shows '<button> cannot be descendant of <button>' - create-channel-button is nested inside channels-section-toggle button in Sidebar.js. This causes React hydration error and is invalid HTML.
WebSocket reconnect: WS shows 'closed before connection established' warning - likely a timing issue in reconnect logic

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 100% pass. Frontend core flows all work. Main issues: (1) Duplicate messages after sending - needs deduplication in ChatContext WS handler or exclude sender in broadcast_room. (2) Button-inside-button HTML invalid structure in Sidebar.js (create-channel-button inside channels-section-toggle button). Check if reaction emoji picker opens on hover (data-testid='add-reaction-button').
rca_of_duplicate_messages: Root cause: backend broadcast_room(room_id, msg) sends to ALL subscribers including sender (no exclude). Frontend sendMessage() doesn't optimistically add to state - relies solely on WS event. Single path so should work. Likely cause: React renders twice in dev (StrictMode) or WS reconnects and processes event twice. Fix: In ChatContext WS handler for 'message' type, check if message ID already in state before appending.
